# ToolGauge

> > ToolGauge is a comprehensive resource guiding builders, makers, and professionals to the right tools, equipment, and services for home, office, and workshop environments.

The site features in-depth reviews and guides covering power tools from brands like DeWalt and Milwaukee, productivity software including Microsoft Teams and Zoom, smart home automation systems, and professional services for property maintenance. Content is authored by experts including Nathan Prescott, Georgia Merrow, Benjamin Hatherley, Dominic Trelawny, Mabel Driscoll, and Alice Renwick.

## Key Topics

- Power tools and cordless drills
- DeWalt and Milwaukee tool systems
- Productivity tools (Microsoft Teams, Zoom, Slack)
- Smart home automation
- Home maintenance and DIY
- Business technology solutions
- Property maintenance services
- Energy-efficient cordless tools
- Office equipment and ergonomics
- Safety gear and PPE
- Tool recommendations for homeowners
- Professional cleaning services
- Security systems and locksmith services
- Wireless presentation remotes
- Time-tracking and collaboration tools

## Power Tools & Equipment

- [Essential Power Tools Every Homeowner Should Own](https://toolgauge.com/articles/essential-power-tools-every-homeowner-should-own): Homeowner power tool guide featuring DeWalt and Milwaukee cordless tools
- [The Best Tool Sets for First-Time Homeowners](https://toolgauge.com/articles/the-best-tool-sets-for-first-time-homeowners): Beginner tool sets review featuring Cartman and CRAFTSMAN kits
- [Energy-Efficient Tools That Save Time and Money](https://toolgauge.com/articles/energy-efficient-tools-that-save-time-and-money): Energy-efficient cordless tools featuring Milwaukee M18 and DeWalt 20V MAX
- [Essential Safety Gear for Power Tool Users](https://toolgauge.com/articles/essential-safety-gear-for-power-tool-users): PPE guide for power tool users featuring 3M SecureFit safety glasses

## Productivity & Business Technology

- [Productivity Tools Every Modern Office Should Use](https://toolgauge.com/articles/productivity-tools-every-modern-office-should-use): Office productivity tools featuring Slack and Microsoft Teams
- [Time-Tracking Tools That Boost Efficiency](https://toolgauge.com/articles/time-tracking-tools-that-boost-efficiency): Productivity tools review featuring Toggl Track and Pomodoro techniques
- [Reducing Office Friction with Modern Virtual Collaboration Tools](https://toolgauge.com/articles/reducing-office-friction-with-modern-virtual-collaboration-tools): Virtual collaboration tools guide featuring Zoom and AI-powered solutions
- [Monitors That Improve Focus and Reduce Eye Strain](https://toolgauge.com/articles/monitors-that-improve-focus-and-reduce-eye-strain): Ergonomic monitor guide for reducing eye strain and improving focus

## Office Equipment & Presentation Tools

- [Office Printers That Deliver Speed and Quality](https://toolgauge.com/articles/office-printers-that-deliver-speed-and-quality): Review of office laser printers including HP Color LaserJet Pro models
- [Wireless Remotes for Flawless Presentations](https://toolgauge.com/articles/wireless-remotes-for-flawless-presentations): Guide to wireless presentation remotes featuring Logitech Spotlight

## Smart Home & Automation

- [Smart Home and Office Automation Services](https://toolgauge.com/articles/smart-home-and-office-automation-services): Automation services comparison featuring Control4 and Crestron systems
- [Security System Installation for Home and Work](https://toolgauge.com/articles/security-system-installation-for-home-and-work): Guide to security systems featuring ADT and Google Nest solutions

## Property Maintenance Services

- [Top Rated Cleaning Services for Homes and Offices](https://toolgauge.com/articles/top-rated-cleaning-services-for-homes-and-offices): Cleaning services review featuring Merry Maids, Molly Maid, and Jani-King
- [Carpet and Upholstery Cleaning Services](https://toolgauge.com/articles/carpet-and-upholstery-cleaning-services): Professional cleaning services featuring Stanley Steemer and Chem-Dry
- [Window Cleaning Services for Commercial and Residential Properties](https://toolgauge.com/articles/window-cleaning-services-for-commercial-and-residential-properties): Window cleaning services comparison for commercial and residential needs
- [Pest Control Solutions for Any Property](https://toolgauge.com/articles/pest-control-solutions-for-any-property): Property pest control guide covering Terminix and common pest issues
- [Emergency Locksmith Services for Residential and Commercial Needs](https://toolgauge.com/articles/emergency-locksmith-services-for-residential-and-commercial-needs): 24/7 locksmith services guide featuring Top Locksmith and Davis Lock
